en: I did not catch that; please say it once more.
why: Repeating a whole utterance from the start is 遍. 趟 is for trips, 顿 for meals and 个 is not a measure for actions.
py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ qǐng nín zài shuō yī biàn

q: 我们刚搬家，租了一___两室一厅的房子。
zh: 我们刚搬家，租了一套两室一厅的房子。
en: We have just moved and rented a two-bedroom flat.
why: A flat or a set is counted with 套. 双 is for pairs, 杯 for glasses and 份 for portions.
py: wǒ men gāng bān jiā zū le yī tào liǎng shì yī tīng de fáng zi

q: 妈妈每天早上都给爷爷准备一___热牛奶，再煮一___粥。
zh: 妈妈每天早上都给爷爷准备一杯热牛奶，再煮一碗粥。
en: Every morning Mom prepares a glass of hot milk for Grandpa and cooks a bowl of porridge.
why: Milk goes in a glass (杯) and porridge in a bowl (碗). 杯 for porridge is wrong, and 瓶 would mean a bottle of hot milk.
py: mā mā měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu gěi yé yé zhǔn bèi yī bēi rè niú nǎi zài zhǔ yī wǎn zhōu

zh: 姐姐在商店买了一双红鞋。
en: My older sister bought a pair of red shoes at the shop.
why: The measure 双 follows the number and precedes the noun phrase: 一双红鞋. The place phrase 在商店 comes before the verb.
py: jiě jiě zài shāng diàn mǎi le yī shuāng hóng xié

q: 爷爷有一___旧自行车。
zh: 爷爷有一辆旧自行车。
en: Grandpa has an old bicycle.
why: A bicycle has wheels, so 辆. 台 is for machines, 只 for small animals and 匹 for horses.
py: yé yé yǒu yī liàng jiù zì xíng chē

s: 我买了些东西，都放在厨房里了。
zh: 我买了些东西，都放在厨房里了。
en: I bought some things, and I put them all in the kitchen.
why: After a verb the 一 of 一些 may be dropped, so 买了些东西 is correct.
py: wǒ mǎi le xiē dōng xi dōu fàng zài chú fáng lǐ le
s_py: wǒ mǎi le xiē dōng xi dōu fàng zài chú fáng lǐ le

q: 超市里的袜子很便宜，我买了三___。
zh: 超市里的袜子很便宜，我买了三双。
en: Socks are cheap at the supermarket, so I bought three pairs.
why: Socks come in pairs, so 双. 条 and 件 are for trousers and tops, and 瓶 is for bottles.
py: chāo shì lǐ de wà zi hěn pián yi wǒ mǎi le sān shuāng

q: 爸爸昨天买了一___新车。
zh: 爸爸昨天买了一辆新车。
en: Dad bought a new car yesterday.
why: Anything on wheels takes 辆. 只 is for small animals, 匹 for horses and 头 for cattle and pigs.
py: bà bà zuó tiān mǎi le yī liàng xīn chē

q: 那三___书都是爸爸买给我的。
zh: 那三本书都是爸爸买给我的。
en: Those three books were all bought for me by Dad.
why: With 那 plus a number the measure still goes right before the noun: 那三本书. 那三书 and 那三些书 are impossible, and 个书 is wrong.
py: nà sān běn shū dōu shì bà bà mǎi gěi wǒ de

s: 我想买一个杯子送给奶奶。
zh: 我想买一个杯子送给奶奶。
en: I want to buy a cup as a gift for Grandma.
why: When the cup itself is what you count, 个 is correct: 一个杯子. 一杯 would count what is inside it.
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī gè bēi zi sòng gěi nǎi nǎi
s_py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī gè bēi zi sòng gěi nǎi nǎi

zh: 我们买了一些书。
en: We bought some books.
why: 一些 already fills the measure slot, so 本 cannot follow it: say 一些书.
py: wǒ men mǎi le yī xiē shū
s_py: wǒ men mǎi le yī xiē běn shū

zh: 我只有三本书。
en: I only have three books.
why: 些 only goes with 一, 这, 那 or 哪. With the number three the measure must be 本.
py: wǒ zhǐ yǒu sān běn shū
s_py: wǒ zhǐ yǒu sān xiē shū

zh: 我们每天睡八个小时。
en: We sleep eight hours every day.
why: Duration needs 个 between the number and 小时: 八个小时. The time word 每天 may stand before or after the subject.
py: wǒ men měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí

q: 妈妈在银行工作，那___银行就在我们家楼下。
zh: 妈妈在银行工作，那家银行就在我们家楼下。
en: Mom works at a bank, and that bank is right below our flat.
why: A bank is a business, so 家. 层 is for floors, 位 for polite people and 口 for family members.
py: mā mā zài yín háng gōng zuò nà jiā yín háng jiù zài wǒ men jiā lóu xià

q: 我在网上给妈妈订了一___外套，可是尺码有点儿大。
zh: 我在网上给妈妈订了一件外套，可是尺码有点儿大。
en: I ordered Mom a coat online, but the size is a bit big.
why: A coat is a top, so 件. 条 is for trousers and skirts, 张 for flat things and 把 for handles.
py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng gěi mā mā dìng le yī jiàn wài tào kě shì chǐ mǎ yǒu diǎn r dà

zh: 爸爸喝了一杯咖啡。
en: Dad drank a cup of coffee.
why: The container 杯 sits between the number and the noun with nothing else in the way: 一杯咖啡.
py: bà bà hē le yī bēi kā fēi

zh: 我买了一条裤子。
en: I bought a pair of trousers.
why: Trousers are not two separate items. They take 条, even though English says 'a pair of'.
py: wǒ mǎi le yī tiáo kù zi
s_py: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng kù zi

q: 桌子上有一___水果，有苹果，也有香蕉。
zh: 桌子上有一些水果，有苹果，也有香蕉。
en: There is some fruit on the table: apples and bananas.
why: 一些 goes straight onto the noun and means 'some', here several kinds of fruit. 一个水果 would be a single piece, which apples and bananas together contradict, and 本 and 张 do not suit fruit.
py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī xiē shuǐ guǒ yǒu píng guǒ yě yǒu xiāng jiāo

zh: 我想买这本书。
en: I want to buy this book.
why: The pointing word 这 comes before the measure 本, which comes right before 书. Putting 本 before 这 or dropping it is wrong.
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi zhè běn shū

zh: 他骑了一匹马去山上。
en: He rode a horse up the mountain.
why: Horses are counted with 匹, never 只.
py: tā qí le yī pǐ mǎ qù shān shàng
s_py: tā qí le yī zhī mǎ qù shān shàng

q: 我早上喝了一___牛奶。
zh: 我早上喝了一杯牛奶。
en: I drank a glass of milk this morning.
why: The container is the measure, so 杯 with no 个. 个牛奶 is wrong, and 条 and 张 are for long or flat things.
py: wǒ zǎo shàng hē le yī bēi niú nǎi

q: 请给我两___纸，我要写信。
zh: 请给我两张纸，我要写信。
en: Please give me two sheets of paper; I want to write a letter.
why: Paper is flat, so 张. 本 is for bound volumes, 条 for long bendy things and 把 for handles.
py: qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng zhāng zhǐ wǒ yào xiě xìn

q: 奶奶生病住院了，妈妈这个星期已经去了三___医院。
zh: 奶奶生病住院了，妈妈这个星期已经去了三趟医院。
en: Grandma is ill in hospital, and Mom has already gone to the hospital three times this week.
why: Going to a place and coming back is 趟. 遍 is for going through something start to finish, and 场 and 顿 do not count trips.
py: nǎi nǎi shēng bìng zhù yuàn le mā mā zhè ge xīng qī yǐ jīng qù le sān tàng yī yuàn

q: 妈妈买了这___菜，晚上我们做饭。
zh: 妈妈买了这些菜，晚上我们做饭。
en: Mom bought these vegetables, and we will cook tonight.
why: 这些 means 'these' for several things. 这个菜 is one dish, and 条 and 本 do not fit vegetables.
py: mā mā mǎi le zhè xiē cài wǎn shàng wǒ men zuò fàn

q: 妹妹在院子里摘了一___红花。
zh: 妹妹在院子里摘了一朵红花。
en: My younger sister picked a red flower in the yard.
why: A single flower is counted with 朵. 棵 is for whole trees and plants, 块 for chunks and 条 for long bendy things.
py: mèi mèi zài yuàn zi lǐ zhāi le yī duǒ hóng huā

q: 书店里有几___书，我们进去看看吧。
zh: 书店里有几本书，我们进去看看吧。
en: The bookshop has a few books; let's go in and look.
why: 几 cannot touch the noun, so the book measure 本 is needed. 几书 and 几些书 are impossible, and 个 is not the measure of 书.
py: shū diàn lǐ yǒu jǐ běn shū wǒ men jìn qù kàn kàn ba

q: 公园后面有一___小山，周末我们常去那儿玩。
zh: 公园后面有一座小山，周末我们常去那儿玩。
en: There is a small hill behind the park, and we often play there at weekends.
why: A hill or mountain takes 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses and 层 for floors.
py: gōng yuán hòu miàn yǒu yī zuò xiǎo shān zhōu mò wǒ men cháng qù nà r wán

q: 我学了两___月中文。
zh: 我学了两个月中文。
en: I studied Chinese for two months.
why: To count months you need 个: 两个月. 两月 would read as a calendar month, and 些 clashes with the number.
py: wǒ xué le liǎng gè yuè zhōng wén

q: 妈妈在书店买了一___字典。
zh: 妈妈在书店买了一本字典。
en: Mom bought a dictionary at the bookshop.
why: A dictionary is a bound volume, so 本. 张 is for flat things, 条 for long bendy things and 把 for things with a handle.
py: mā mā zài shū diàn mǎi le yī běn zì diǎn

zh: 邻居养了一只大狗。
en: The neighbour keeps a big dog.
why: Number, measure, then noun phrase: 一只大狗. The measure 只 always follows the number directly.
py: lín jū yǎng le yī zhī dà gǒu

q: 昨晚我们去体育馆看了一___篮球比赛，非常精彩。
zh: 昨晚我们去体育馆看了一场篮球比赛，非常精彩。
en: Last night we went to the stadium to watch a basketball match, and it was brilliant.
why: A match is an event that runs its course, so 场. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 门 for school subjects.
py: zuó wǎn wǒ men qù tǐ yù guǎn kàn le yī chǎng lán qiú bǐ sài fēi cháng jīng cǎi

q: 爸爸给我写了一___长信，说他下个月回家。
zh: 爸爸给我写了一封长信，说他下个月回家。
en: Dad wrote me a long letter saying he comes home next month.
why: Letters are counted with 封. 本 is for books, 片 for thin slices and 块 for chunks.
py: bà bà gěi wǒ xiě le yī fēng cháng xìn shuō tā xià gè yuè huí jiā

q: 我们搬到这个城市已经十___了，和邻居们都很熟了。
zh: 我们搬到这个城市已经十年了，和邻居们都很熟了。
en: We have lived in this city for ten years already and are well acquainted with all the neighbours.
why: 年 is a measure itself, so 十年. 十个年 adds an extra 个, and 些 and 位 do not fit a number of years.
py: wǒ men bān dào zhè ge chéng shì yǐ jīng shí nián le hé lín jū men dōu hěn shú le

q: 爸爸穿了一___蓝裤子。
zh: 爸爸穿了一条蓝裤子。
en: Dad wore a pair of blue trousers.
why: Trousers are long and bendy, so 条. 件 is for tops and 张 for flat things; English 'pair' does not make it 双.
py: bà bà chuān le yī tiáo lán kù zi

q: 你要的那四___衣服，我已经帮你放进箱子里了。
zh: 你要的那四件衣服，我已经帮你放进箱子里了。
en: I have already put the four pieces of clothing you wanted into the suitcase.
why: The pattern 那 + number + measure + noun needs 件 for clothes. 那四衣服 skips the measure, 些 clashes with the number four, and 个 is not used for clothes.
py: nǐ yào de nà sì jiàn yī fu wǒ yǐ jīng bāng nǐ fàng jìn xiāng zi lǐ le

s: 妈妈给我买了一个新裤子。
zh: 妈妈给我买了一条新裤子。
en: Mom bought me a new pair of trousers.
why: Trousers are long and bendy and take 条. 个 is not used for them.
py: mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yī tiáo xīn kù zi
s_py: mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè xīn kù zi

q: 这本小说我看了两___，每次都有新的感觉。
zh: 这本小说我看了两遍，每次都有新的感觉。
en: I have read this novel twice and each time felt something new.
why: Reading a book from cover to cover is 遍. 趟 is for trips, 场 for events and 顿 for meals.
py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn měi cì dōu yǒu xīn de gǎn jué

q: 奶奶的农场里有两___牛，还有一___马。
zh: 奶奶的农场里有两头牛，还有一匹马。
en: Grandma's farm has two cows and also a horse.
why: Cattle take 头 and horses take 匹, in that order. Swapping them is wrong, and 只 or 条 do not fit large farm animals.
py: nǎi nǎi de nóng chǎng lǐ yǒu liǎng tóu niú hái yǒu yī pǐ mǎ

q: 课间休息十分钟，下一___课是数学。
zh: 课间休息十分钟，下一节课是数学。
en: After a ten-minute break the next class is maths.
why: A class period on the timetable is 节. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 条 for long bendy things.
py: kè jiān xiū xī shí fēn zhōng xià yī jié kè shì shù xué
